summary: Ten metres of kerb right at a junction, in front of a house.
reasons: At a junction with give-way markings

drivers.seclusion: Houses 11 m and 14 m from the kerb, directly facing it; exposed at an open junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow grass strip and driveway beside the kerb; no pull-in clear of the lane at the junction.
drivers.traffic: Through road and side-street junction, with moving and turning traffic in both images.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb.

sun_shade: Open to the sky; the building on the north side shades it in the morning.
cannot_judge: Slope: 10 m is too short for a meaningful DEM grade
